text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The final adjustment day before the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn). Beyond it lies the Arima 
Kinen, the stage for the showdown with 
Narita Brian...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide told the Trainer to rest 
early and headed home. However, left alone 
in the room, the Trainer continued their 
research on Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The more the Trainer learned of the 
rival's strength, the more anxiety closed 
in. Cutting into even sleep, the Trainer's 
exhaustion had already reached its peak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide returned to the Trainer. 
Noticing the Trainer was pushing 
themselves too hard alone, she was angry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If either of them collapsed, the dream 
would be over. Tears welled in Biwa 
Hayahide's eyes as she pleaded her case. 
The Trainer reconsidered and decided to 
turn in early.
